notes.content:

[h2]New mechanism:[/h2]

New wingman support added to adventure mode

6 completely different wingmen are available as disposable items, unlocked after the first level of adventure mode

notes.title: Version 0.9.9 Beta Mega update!
notes.content:
[h1]Update log of Version 0.9.9 Beta[/h1]

[h1]BIG Progression Update！[/h1]

[h3]Adventure mode now is alive！[/h3]

Fighters will get different enhancements in adventure mode, including a wide selection of main/secondary weapons and energy release. The content of this mode has also been much more.

Arcade mode has been completely reworked and is now completely played in the traditional arcade mode, using the traditional 8 level system. Depending on the difficulty your choice, the level you face will be different.

The opening and ending scenes were added to the game.

Fighter pilots can speak now, only Chinese so far.

[h3]New Fighter coming![/h3]

H-0727,”the hammerhead shark”, striker

[h3]Mechanics:[/h3]

In Arcade mode, now will have chance to drop P items (powerup boost) when player crashed

All items in Arcade mode can be carried to the next level.

[h3]Interface:[/h3]

Added skip animation Settings.

[h3]Balance:[/h3]

Almost all fighters have been adjusted, too many data changes are not described here, you can enter the game experience.

[h3]Bugfix:[/h3]

Fixed an issue where some enemy units' exploding fragments did not match their own colors.

notes.title: Version 0.9.5 Beta！
notes.content:
[b][h1]Update log of Version 0.9.5 Beta[/h1][/b]

[h3]Interface：[/h3]

Completely redo the settings interface

Add following functions to the Settings menu：

Switch to full screen/window mode, in window mode,  you can resize the window as much as you like

Difficulty selection, note that the difficulty design takes more time to complete and currently there is only a preliminary version

Switch to handle vibration function

Controller settings

These changes need more test feedback. If any bug appears, please let us know in time, thanks

[h3]Stage:[/h3]

New stages
Add 3 more stages
7-1
7-2
7-3

Although we've done a lot of testing on the new stages, there's always the question of whether we've tested it enough. If you have a bad experience, please don't hesitate to give suggestions to us. Thank you！ 

[h3]Balance:[/h3]

All enemy units HP increased by 30% in 2 player mode

Bonus boosters are easier to pick up(Now they have a larger collision volume, based on the actual graph of the bonus boosters)

No longer charge when hitting a wall

[h3]Design changes[/h3]

Victory screens now will appear faster in stages without a BOSS(e.g. stage 2-1 stage 3-2)

Turn down the default volume to 80

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]

Fixed an issue where the background layer of some levels would sometimes become distorted after pressing pause

Fixed an issue where stage 5-2 could not be won in some special situations

Fixed an issue that after Mega Power completes recharge,  player releasing the recharge button during pause time will display the first frame of Mega Power

Fixed an issue where the first frame of the Direction Warning UI would sometimes appear in the correct position after flashing on the screen in stage 5-2

notes.title: Devlog 2021/4/24
notes.content:
[h2]We've received a lot of feedback and questions from players since the game launched. Some players are very professional and passionate，thank you！[/h2]

[h3]Most players feedback problems are as follows:[/h3]
1. The controller cannot be modified
2. The stages are difficult and the difficulty curve is not smooth enough
3. Bonus boosters are difficult to pick up
4. Window mode cannot be resized
5. No vibration switch for handle
6. The volume is too high

After receiving those feedback, we made some positive improvements to the game.

Function adjustment

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063787/6fa2d3784d1e181c1e369c80f5cc852464c9fe52.png[/img]
-Completely redo the settings interface，now you can modify the controller even when you are in the battle.
-Now you can resize the window as much as you like
-Difficulty selection has been added. Note that the difficulty selection is currently incomplete as the level balance is incomplete and still needs to be adjusted
-Added handle vibration Settings

[h3]New Stages![/h3]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063787/c6f2e290ccff78c78caccb95efc457fa3610fef4.png[/img]
						        New scene

New stages will be introduced soon. Stage 7, "Underground Dump" (tentatively named), will be divided into three mini-levels, as before.
Lovely fighter pilots need to enter the underground dump of a space city, which will have new enemies and bosses.

There is also some progress in the story of the game, and some illustrations of the game have been prepared after player finishing the game. See below:
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063787/421beb6bb2541b65b1d261f50ca8581fcd9f3405.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40063787/585a3fc2d05c9e0bf58cf2c0ae25e737c2d9952c.png[/img]

We'll try our best to bring you these updates by the end of April

Well, that's all we've done in this period of time. We'll update the dev log weekly in the future. Hope you can support us and give us some good suggestions and ideas. Thank you!

-Now you can resize the window as much as you like
-Difficulty selection has been added. Note that the difficulty selection is currently incomplete as the level balance is incomplete and still needs to be adjusted
-Added handle vibration Settings
